{{- /* The "before your call" checklist: the lists and headings of checklist in data/labels.toml, its single source, read through label-list.html and label.html. Called with a dict: details false on Home (titles only, under the card's h2), true on Before your call (titles with details, plus the "if you already ran it" warning panel). Warning tiles are the only orange on the page besides the CTA and the warning panel (SPEC section 7). */ -}} {{- $fields := slice "title" -}} {{- $details := .details -}} {{- $h := cond $details "h2" "h3" -}}
{{- range slice (dict "id" "warning-signs" "title" (partial "label.html" "checklist.warning_heading") "items" (partial "label-list.html" (dict "key" "checklist.warning" "fields" $fields)) "tile" "tile-warn" "icon" "warning") (dict "id" "do-this-instead" "title" (partial "label.html" "checklist.instead_heading") "items" (partial "label-list.html" (dict "key" "checklist.instead" "fields" $fields)) "tile" "tile-ok" "icon" "check") }}
{{ printf `<%s id="%s">%s` $h .id (htmlEscape .title) $h | safeHTML }}
    {{- $item := . }} {{- range .items }}
  • {{ partial "icon.html" $item.icon }}
    {{ if $details }}

    {{ .title }}

    {{ with .detail }}

    {{ . }}

    {{ end }}{{ else }}{{ .title }}{{ end }}
    • {{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- if $details }}

{{ partial "icon.html" "warning" }}{{ partial "label.html" "checklist.already_ran_heading" }}

    {{- range partial "label-list.html" (dict "key" "checklist.already_ran" "fields" $fields) }}

  1. {{ .title }}

    {{ with .detail }}

    {{ . }}

    {{ end }}
    2. {{- end }}
{{- end }}
